Welcome to the NHL Privacy Portal!Welcome to the NHL’s Privacy portal. You may use this portal to exercise certain rights and choices you may have under data protection laws. Please see the NHL Privacy Policy for more information about how the NHL collects, uses, and shares your information, and your rights and choices. For information about Member Club privacy practices and choices, please see the applicable Member Club’s Privacy Policy. To learn more about our use of cookies, pixels, and similar technologies, please see our Cookie Policy here. To adjust your preferences at any time, visit the NHL Cookie Preference Center (for NHL.com and, where applicable, other relevant sites) and the Privacy Settings in relevant NHL mobile applications (e.g., in the NHL App, click on the gear icon and visit Privacy Settings). Please select the type of request you wish to make and fill out the form below to submit your request. You will then receive a link to verify your email address. Please note that this portal is currently available only to residents in the United States, Canada, European Economic Area (i.e., the EU, Iceland, Lichtenstein and Norway), Switzerland and United Kingdom. For other residents who wish to exercise their rights and choices, please visit nhl.com/contact to submit your request and select the “Privacy” option in the subject line (or click on the Cookie Policy link or other settings set forth above to adjust your preferences regarding cookies, pixels and similar technologies). If you have any questions, please contact the NHL Privacy Officer at privacy@nhl.com. Thank you!The NHL Privacy Officer Country Enter country of residence. *  I am a (an)  Required  Fan/Consumer  First Name Enter the first name of the data subject Last Name Enter the last name of the data subject Email Enter email for correspondence with the data request.
